proof: For a,b>0, ds/dt=sqrt(a^2+b^2). Cross squared=a^2(a^2+b^2), triple=a^2 b. Thus kappa=a/(a^2+b^2), tau=b/(a^2+b^2), kappa:tau=a:b. Frenet signs T,N,B are consistent.
Dot product a.b=3; (a+b)^2=19, (2a-b)^2=13, (a-b)^2=7 and (a+b).(a-b)=-5. Diagonal cosine=-5/sqrt(133).
Subtract planes to get y+2z=5; taking z=t gives (t-4,5-2t,t). Independent normals give rank 2, so the parametrization is complete.

Keep row 4, subtract it from rows 1..3; expand 4x4 along column 1 with sign (-1)^5, then the displayed 3x3 along ROW 1: -[(-3)*2]=6. Three scene labels repaired; formula/source occurrence inventory identical.
For n>=2, Ri<-Ri-R1 for i>=2; sum all columns into column 1. This makes column 1=(na+b,0,...,0)^T, with lower minor bI_(n-1); no division. n=1 is a+b. Includes b=0.
R^n=span(1) direct sum {x:sum x_i=0}. J acts by n and 0 respectively, so bI+aJ acts by b+na and b. Determinant=(b+na)b^(n-1); the factors remain valid when a=0 and eigenvalues coincide.

Expand each column be_j+a1 multilinearly. Terms with >=2 all-1 columns vanish; all b columns give b^n; exactly one all-1 column gives ab^(n-1), because det(e1,...,1,...,en)=1 (expand 1=sum e_k; only k=j survives). Sum n such terms; n=1 treated as a+b. No division, so b=0 covered. The complete 3x3 replacement determinant notation is repaired.
